items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: He was hired by Walter Hubbard.

ctx.x: Where did you play? I said...

He was my husband's band. It was the first band, colored band, played at the auditorium. Oh, I see. That was the... During a carnival. He was hired by... It's so hard, we were in between, I just stopped up. He was hired by Walter Hubbard. You know, he used to work for all them people, you know, that had to call for parades. And... Paran. I said Uncle Richard. And... Thomas Copeland. Izel and all that. And I believe he had that boy, Moran Whitton, that time. And after he played there, that's where Duke Ellington…
Was he about your husband's age?
